claim.purpose: Implement the typed operator-authorized active-claim revoke operation

initial.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tools] Add explicit operator active-claim revoke
initial.goal: Provide a narrow typed CAS-guarded operator operation to revoke an abandoned active claim without waiting for lease expiry or hand-editing canonical state.
initial.required_outcome: A schema-visible csdlc-bind revoke route, atomic claim clearing, audit evidence, and focused fail-closed tests.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Revoke request is versioned, schema-visible, and requires exact issue/generation/digest/claim identity.
AC-2: Explicit operator authority and non-empty reason are mandatory.
AC-3: Successful revoke atomically clears only the matching claim and appends audit evidence without changing phase.
AC-4: Stale, mismatched, or incomplete requests fail closed without mutation.
AC-5: Focused tests and strict Clippy pass with no AWS, raw gh, shell/Python lifecycle, or network behavior.
authority_boundary: Only an explicit operator-authorized request may revoke a live claim; ordinary expiry recovery and closeout remain unchanged.
initial.task_boundary: Implement and validate the typed active-claim revoke operation.
dependencies: csdlc-v2 lifecycle/store and typed bind route

steps.action: Implement typed revoke request/result and atomic store operation
Run focused tests, Clippy, exact review, and publish

invariants: audit records prior owner and authority

validation_lanes.proof_role: typed request, CAS, authorization, audit, and unchanged-phase safety

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve the canonical record.
review_prompts: Check operator authority and CAS boundaries
Check no direct state or secret leakage
initial.review_scope: active-claim revoke lifecycle operation and focused tests
initial.plan_summary: Add the typed request and atomic store operation, test fail-closed CAS/authority behavior, review the exact head, and publish the narrow tooling fix.
